list_cache_repositories: list cached Hugging Face repositories with filtering, sorting, and output in table, JSON, or CSV format
list_cache_revisions: list cached Hugging Face model revisions with size, modification time, and ref filters
remove_cache_repos: remove cached Hugging Face repositories or specific revision hashes from the local cache
prune_detached_revisions: prune unreferenced detached revisions from the Hugging Face local cache to free disk space
verify_repo_checksums: verify checksums for a Hugging Face repo revision against the local cache or a local directory
